scope: Identity evidence for a compact batch of unresolved members of the 2017 PCA Ad Interim Committee on Women Serving in the Ministry of the Church.
modeling_rule: These records support person-identity reconciliation only. They do not assign any report-level theological position, either internal school of thought, or broader ideological label to an individual committee member.

evidence.fact: The official 2017 committee roster prints TE Dan Doriani as an Advisory Member.
Covenant Theological Seminary identifies Dr. Daniel M. Doriani as Professor of Biblical and Systematic Theology and documents his long faculty and pastoral history.
Covenant Seminary's 2026 magazine page uses the public name form 'Dr. Dan Doriani' for its faculty profile.

records.match_basis: The committee's Dan Doriani is supported by Covenant Seminary's first-party use of the same public name form and its canonical Daniel M. Doriani faculty profile. The identity match is reviewed as high-confidence, but canonical mutation is deferred to a separate slice.
records.reasoning_boundary: Identity only; committee service does not establish agreement with every statement in the report.
